args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, per Ironbark's retail returns logistics post.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (about 20%).
- Per the companion piece, reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns and https://insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion
args.title: Ironbark blog: Retail returns — combined summary
